validation.note: Each candidate was cropped to the manifest path and checked before generating the next. Painting checks cover dimensions and aspect ratio; composition was visually compared.

selectionReason: Candidate 3 has the quietest, most evenly textured lawn and a tidy background-only forest. Tent, fire ring and two bowls form the requested campsite group.

UNIFIED STYLE: premium cozy mobile-game look in the spirit of Pokémon Sleep: soft 3D-rendered cartoon,
round chunky shapes, matte clay-like material with gentle subsurface softness, warm cheerful pastel
colors, soft daylight from the upper left, gentle ambient occlusion, clean tidy edges, no hard black
outlines, no text, no labels, no watermark, no UI, no borders. Everything is cute, friendly and calm.

PROMPT: Repaint reference image 1 (a rough blockout of a camp) as a finished, high-end mobile-game main
scene in UNIFIED STYLE, portrait 3:4, camera tilted about 45–50 degrees looking down. Keep the layout
EXACTLY as in the blockout, at the SAME sizes: one big cozy camping tent at the upper left of the fire (about
one third of the image width) with its door open toward the fire, a stone campfire ring just below and to the
right of the tent, two empty food bowls at the lower right of the fire; these three form one close campsite
group. Everything else is one wide, open, even meadow reaching the left, right and bottom edges. A band of
round forest trees only along the top edge, with soft hills and sky beyond. No trees inside the meadow, no
stream, no pond, no deck, no rocks, no paths. The meadow must be a clean, even, uniform lawn with
only tiny flowers and subtle grass texture: no paths, no patches, no rocks, no clutter (decorations will
be pasted on it later). Soft morning light, gentle shadows under the trees, calm and cozy.

Use case: sketch-to-render. Image 1 is the NEW padded blockout to repaint; it alone controls the layout, sizes and spacing. Image 2 supplies only the polished soft 3D mobile-game rendering style; do not copy its buildings, text or objects.
Output exactly 1024x1536 pixels, opaque portrait PNG. The 3:4 game scene is the central part y=85..1450; only the extra top and bottom padding will be cropped. Keep the reference's normalized positions. On this final padded canvas the big tent silhouette spans approximately x=153..467, peak (310,439), base at y=832, warm cream canvas with orange trim, tied-open doorway facing down-right toward the fire. Its entire silhouette is about one third of the image width. Fire ring center (512,979), width about 173px and height 113px, small flame, one log to the right around (656,1035). Empty bowl centers (673,1132) and (747,1149), each about 67px wide. Forest is confined to the horizontal BACKGROUND strip above the grass boundary near y=325. These coordinates are silent placement guidance, never drawn. The campsite group must keep these sizes and gaps, no arbitrary recentering.
An uninterrupted FLAT open meadow reaches the entire left, right and bottom edges. No foreground or side trees, no side hedges, no water, no deck, no rocks except the campfire ring, no pathways, no furniture, no animals, no people. The tent is the only building. Keep lawn color extremely even and calm, with very delicate fine texture and just sparse tiny white flowers. Avoid mottled broad grass patches, thick flower clumps, bare earth, dramatic shadows and vignettes. Soft morning light and small soft contact shadows.
Candidate 1 of 3: emphasize the exact large blockout silhouette of the tent and a very clean uniform velvety spring-green lawn.
